specification.selection: all primes below1000 in ascending order

mastering.per_source_policy: gain_db=min(max(0,-19-rms_dbfs),-4.5-peak_dbfs), a measured calibration of the established series linear mix policy
mastering.method: Nonoverlapping accepted speech resampled24kmono to48kstereo; optional one uniform linear gain per source under the established RMS/peak policy, followed by one measured common delivery gain. No limiting, compression, time stretch or source-file changes; silent gaps preserved. Exact per-source gains are recorded on voice_events.

scope: Automated full decode, independent number/glyph/diagram checks, source and AAC recognition/waveform/boundary review and selected still review. No full human continuous viewing/listening claim.
